newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers flat, holidays stifle trade.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers flat, holidays stifle trade.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were little changed on Monday and business very thin as holidays in much of Europe stifled trade, brokers and traders said.
"It is very quiet," one London-based dealer said.

Rotterdam 380 cst bunkers were worth around $86 a tonne, unchanged from Friday. Gas oil was a little firmer, buoyed by gains on the IPE which rose in what brokers said was a catch-up to late gains in crude oil prices on Friday, after the IPE gas oil market had closed.
Mediterranean bunkers were also little changed, with 380 cst in Augusta valued at $94 and 180 cst fuel worth around $7 a tonne more.
